description: Land Acquisition - Bambarenda, Dickwella D/S Division, Matara District and two other notices
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains declarations for acquiring specific parcels of land for public purposes, detailed descriptions of land boundaries and extents, and corrections to previous land acquisition notices. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
